experiments.scope: H1 (unconditional first blocks), H5 and the Lemma 4.1 identities on real first blocks (proof.md Sections 4, 7, 13). Trials 0..7: first 64 unconditional organizer-seeded first blocks per trial, the W7 passes of all 32 classes counted without selection (expectation 137.0 per trial under H1); then first blocks drawn from the organizer seed (two uniform 256-bit words from SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and seed per first block; real 38-step compressions) until one has a passing class (at most 64); its first passing class is run on two batches (its first 512 members): the counted row-16 program of that class is executed instruction by instruction and its ok plane compared lane by lane with E16x computed from the Step-2 words and the 38-step trace; W7 is compared with c7 - A_{-1} and checked in F7. Trial 0 also runs the batch of the semi-free-start pair's variant on its chaining value: the counted program must find and accept it (positive lanes). Returns M0 || M1 and M0 || M1' of the class's first member (128 bytes each; one variant of one chaining value, not a collision) iff there is no mismatch. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 8 (every executed trial mismatch-free); full collisions of the target: 0 (a returned pair is not a collision). Observations (untrusted): uncond_first_blocks (64), uncond_class_passes (H1: mean 137.0 per trial; grouped passes give a large variance), first_blocks, passing_classes, lanes (512), stage3a_passes, mismatches (0). Validation by us: 8 pairs returned per request, 0 mismatches, at most 0.5 s; unconditional: 5,514 class W7 passes in 2,560 first blocks against 5,480 expected.

experiments.scope: Consistency check of the q3 estimator (H2; proof.md Sections 6, 9, 13): it is not an estimate of q3 and not evidence for the bound q3_model, which rests on the participant study. Trials 0..9: 10 independent replicates of the estimator of q3 for the accepted event (row 16 exact over the 160 W16 words; rows 17..22 by proposals with the row's E bits imposed, at row 19 one of the four observed condition patterns drawn uniformly with weight 4 x 2^-f and the row checked on signed differences; tail: a variant of 512 embedded samples of the selected classes, W7 uniform in F7 (its three affine families; the family drawn by rejection from its own word, the value bits from a fresh word), rows 23..37, outputs compared; randomness SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and trial seed). Every success is rebuilt into (CV1, M1, M1') and accepted only if the two 38-step compressions from CV1 are equal, M1 != M1', the pair is in the accepted event and W7 is in F7. Trial t < 10 returns its first verified pair as CV1 || M1 and CV1 || M1' (96 bytes each; semi-free-start collisions, never collisions from the IV); trial 10 returns a pair iff no rebuild failed and the mean of the 10 estimates is at least 2^-98.6000; trials 11..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: one semi-free-start pair per replicate with a tail success (development requests: 4 to 10 of 10 replicates; validation by us: 7 to 9) and 1 from trial 10 (a pass; trial 10 needs trials 0..9 in the same request); full collisions of the target: 0. The pass rule was fixed from 48 development requests (pooled means: min -98.100, median -96.398) before any validation run; a pass checks a reduced replica, it is not an estimate of q3. Observations (untrusted): log2_estimate (-1000 for no success), accepted_pairs, failed_rebuilds (0); trial 10 log2_pooled_mean. What a pass shows: the replica estimates the same event as the study, restricted to the four row-19 patterns (a lower bound) and to 512 of the selected variants; its 48 development requests (480 replicates) have mean 2^-96.2059 against the study mean 2^-96.1821. Shifting their pooled means down by 1, 2 or 3 bits (a q3 that much lower) makes 2%, 38% and 90% of requests fail the rule (none at the claimed level): a pass excludes a gross error in the estimator or the program, it does not certify the bound.
